faq.title: [tr] Common questions
faq.priceA: [tr] The platform sets it from your answers to the service questions. You see it before you post and it does not change after. Providers apply at the listed price, with no price offers and no haggling.
faq.payA: [tr] Posting is free and you pay nothing when you post. After you compare offers and choose one provider, you pay the commission online. It is part of the price. You pay the rest to the provider in cash after the job.
faq.dataA: [tr] Providers see only the district, the date and the price. Your name, number and full address stay hidden. They open to the chosen provider, and theirs to you, only after you pay the commission and the provider pays their fee.
faq.contactQ: [tr] Can I contact a provider before choosing?
faq.contactA: [tr] There is no chat before you choose. You compare by ratings, the provider's message and their answers. Those messages are checked automatically, and any number, email or link is refused.
faq.unhappyQ: [tr] What if I am not happy with the job?
faq.unhappyA: [tr] You can report a problem. The admin reviews it, can warn or suspend the provider, and can refund a fee by hand. The cash is between you and the provider, and the platform does not collect it for anyone.
faq.cancelA: [tr] Yes. Before you pay there is nothing to pay. If you cancel after paying the commission and before contact details open, the commission is refunded. After they open there is no automatic refund, and the admin may refund a fee by hand.
faq.providerQ: [tr] How do I register as a provider?
faq.providerA: [tr] Sign up with your mobile number, then complete your profile and documents: ID, a live photo and your criminal record. You cannot apply until the admin approves you. Applying is free, and you pay a fee only on a request where you are chosen.

Landing.closingBody: [tr] We connect you with a provider and take only our fees. The commission is part of the price, paid online. The rest goes in cash after the job.
